meta.name: reflecting-on-sessions
meta.description: Use when completing a plan, finishing a development branch, wrapping up a session, or at any natural transition between work phases — reviews skill-bus telemetry to identify subscription gaps and suggest improvements

copy.tagline: 回顾工作阶段，发现技能使用缺口并优化
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常在完成计划或开发分支后想改进工作方式
copy.tagline_en: Review work phases, identify skill usage gaps, and suggest improvements
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often want to improve your workflow after completing a plan or development branch

howto.what: 它会检查技能总线的使用记录，告诉你哪些技能没有订阅、哪些被跳过，并建议优化。
howto.when: 完成计划、结束开发分支、会话收尾或工作阶段自然切换时触发。

say.text: 帮我看看这次会话的技能总线使用情况。
say.note: 触发反射检查并显示统计。
检查未订阅的技能并建议添加。

howto.what_en: It reviews skill-bus telemetry to identify subscription gaps and skipped conditions, then suggests improvements.
howto.when_en: Triggered after completing a plan, finishing a development branch, wrapping up a session, or at natural transitions between work phases.

say_en.text: Check the skill-bus activity for this session.
Are there any skills without subscriptions?
say_en.note: Identifies uncovered skills and offers to add subscriptions.
